annotations.title: Try a withdrawal before making it (free up to $1,000)

description: TRY ONE WITHDRAWAL FROM A VAULT BEFORE YOU MAKE IT. Runs the vault’s own withdraw(amount, holder, holder) by eth_call at the head block, as the holder you name or, if you name none, as its largest depositor: the contract executes and nothing is signed, sent or spent. Says whether it would have gone through, the revert reason where it would not (e.g. NotEnoughLiquidity, TransferReverted past a V2 vault’s idle balance), the block, and what the holder’s position was worth; a size over what the holder owns is tried at their position and said so. It does NOT show a later block, or what happens once somebody else takes the same free money. Morpho vaults for now; anything else answers `simulated: false` and is not charged. FREE up to $1,000; over it PAID, $2 a simulation over x402, or free with a decision pass from this vault’s due-diligence report.

amountUsd.description: How much to withdraw, in US dollars. Up to 1000 is free.

holder.description: The address to withdraw as. Leave it out to try as the vault’s largest depositor.

pass.description: A decision pass from this vault’s due-diligence report (its X-ASPERN-Decision-Pass header): simulations over $1,000 on that vault without paying again.

vault.description: The vault slug, or an address we can resolve to one. `list_vaults` or `find_vaults` find a slug.

name: simulate_withdrawal

block.description: The block it was simulated at.

holder.description: The address the withdrawal was tried as.

holderUsd.description: What that holder’s shares were worth at the block.

limitations.description: What one simulation does not show.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

reason.description: The revert reason where it would have reverted.

simulated.description: Whether a withdrawal was run. False where the vault is not one we simulate, no endpoint answered, or there was no holder to try as; nothing is charged then.

triedUsd.description: The amount tried: the amount asked, or the holder’s position less 0.1% where they own less.

vault.description: The vault slug the request resolved to.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

wouldGoThrough.description: True if the withdrawal would have gone through at that block, false if it would have reverted, null where nothing was tried.
